## Why visit

A substantial modern brewery experience with cask and documented real cider alongside the broader draught range. The taproom’s position beside the brewery and view over barrels give context to the beer, while a separately booked brewery tour can add a production-and-tasting experience if one is available during the trip. It is particularly useful for visitors who want one concentrated look at contemporary Manchester brewing. Combine it with Track and choose selected pours; there is no need to treat every line as a target.

## Beer

The operator advertises twenty draught taps plus two cask lines, including current releases and barrel-aged beer.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly identifies Nightingale real cider; confirm the currently stocked product.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

Cold snacks; rotating street-food traders are usually offered at weekends. The operator permits outside food when no trader is present.

## Plan the visit

Book any brewery tour using the current operator calendar; published tour times differ between sources. Taproom access does not itself include a production tour.

**Getting there:** Walk from Piccadilly or New Islington; pair with Track, then Sureshot/Balance on Sheffield Street.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
